title: The three papers
logline: Monday. Three coastal weeklies, three towns, the same strip a week behind. Wood lays them out on the counter like the 2001 frame-shop customers' things. Three towns have him on the wall now.

panels.composition: Gully's. Three weeklies on the counter: Newport, Florence, Waldport. The same strip in each. WOOD arranging them. GULLY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, three small-town newspapers laid side by side on a bait-shop counter each showing the same comic strip, a thin man arranging them
image.notes: Mastheads: reserved; draw three different small-town mastheads, unreadable.

panels.composition: The same strip, three times. One printed darker. One cropped a hair. One with the gull cut off.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of the same comic strip printed three times in three papers with small differences in darkness and cropping

panels.composition: Wood, to Gully, about the gull.

balloons.text: That's the — it's the signature, Gully. That's the whole —

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man pointing at a cropped corner of a newspaper strip to a man in an apron

panels.composition: Wood writing a letter to Florence. Four lines. The gull at the bottom, drawn large, so they'll know.
props: a letter with a large gull
